source: User-exported Z 30 V1.20 Picture Controls, read from /Volumes/SAVE/NIKON/CUSTOMPC on 2026-10-15; card files unchanged.
purpose: Private test fixtures for NP3 versus GetPicCtrlData comparisons; not app presets.

comparison.names: All six 20-byte name fields match, including padding and the trailing space in C4.
comparison.curve_mapping: NP3 tag 00000002 equals GetPicCtrlData bytes 36..613 in C3, C4 and C5, including all 578 bytes.

wire_contract.quick_sharp_flag: 0=off; 1=on ignores the three individual sharpness values. The encoder intentionally writes 0 for these manual NP3 presets.
wire_contract.dataset: GetPicCtrlData and SetPicCtrlData use the same classic 36/614-byte PictureControl DataSet.

limits: The wire contract is now documented, but an actual app-to-camera write still requires phone verification.
These six samples do not establish all NP3 base identifiers, monochrome parameters, automatic-value sentinels or other camera layouts.
This comparison never writes to the camera or the card. Destination policy remains C9 (209) only.
